== Summary ==
Slip “•Qui-Gon Jinn (V)” cut unchanged from page 3 of the Players Committee's [https://res.starwarsccg.org/virtual/Set-27.pdf Virtual Set 27 release sheet] (PDF file created 13 October 2026), rendered at 200 dpi (pixel box (1112, 981, 1624, 1256)). Version [[Qui-Gon Jinn (V)]] (Original). Not a recreation.
